landing.title: Taxes
landing.subtitle: Tools for the deductions and taxes that shape your pay

payrollDeductions.title: Payroll Deductions
payrollDeductions.description: Set yearly maximums on deductions such as pension and employment insurance, and let the paycheque stop collecting them once the maximum is reached.

payroll.title: Payroll Deductions
payroll.subtitle: Yearly maximums on the deduction lines of your payroll bill

emptyState.title: No deduction rules yet
emptyState.body: Pick the scheduled bill that is your paycheque, choose a deduction category and set its yearly maximum. The bill stops collecting it once the maximum is reached and starts again on the reset date.

yearToDate.title: Paid this period
yearToDate.help: What the category has collected in the period that contains today, across every account, in the bill's currency.
yearToDate.foreignRows: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} in another currency not counted

form.billPlaceholder: Select the bill that is your paycheque
form.billHelp: The scheduled deposit whose lines carry the deductions. Only its category lines can be capped.
form.yearlyMaximumHelp: The most this category collects in one period, in the bill's currency. The line is reduced to what room is left, down to zero.
form.resetDateHelp: The count starts again on this day each year. Usually the first day of the year.
form.expectedHelp: The bill has no line for this category, so the forecast needs the amount each paycheque deducts.
form.expectedFromLine: The bill's line deducts {amount} per paycheque.
form.expectedSuggested: Suggested from your most recent transaction in this category.

validation.expectedRequired: Enter the expected amount per paycheque

delete.title: Delete Deduction Rule
delete.message: Delete the {category} rule on {bill}? Posted transactions are not changed; the next paycheque posts its full line.
